item.title: Pakistan and Afghan forces clash along border after days of hostilities
item.description: Pakistani and Afghan forces exchanged heavy fire on Thursday along the mountainous northwest border, escalating tensions after days of cross-border hostilities. The Taliban said its strikes targeted Pakistani posts in response to weekend airstrikes against Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) and Islamic State Khorasan militants allegedly operating from Afghan territory. Both sides claimed to have destroyed or captured opposing posts, though these reports could not be independently verified by media

item.title: Study suggests male Neanderthals more often mated with human females
item.description: New genetic research suggests that interbreeding between Neanderthals and early modern humans occurred more often between male Neanderthals and female humans. The study, published in {Science}, offers a new explanation for why Neanderthal DNA is largely absent from the human X chromosome. item.title: Germany grants military broader powers to counter drones
item.description: Germany's lower house of parliament, the Bundestag, has voted to expand the armed forces' authority to intercept or shoot down drones amid a sharp rise in sightings since Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Lawmakers approved amendments to the air security law enabling quicker and more flexible responses. As reported by Reuters, under the new rules, the Bundeswehr can deploy jamming devices or weapons when civilian authorities request assistance.
